recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-39582 unless a separate R5-to-R6 migration-map issue asks to adjust the historical renderedDosageInstruction mapping entry.
issue_request: FHIR-39582 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to change MedicationRequest.dose.renderedDosageInstruction from string to markdown if it may contain more than one paragraph.
initial_application: Git commit 2b88d1c62bc99724e079a33de0d9f92d4b0e4f86 explicitly applied FHIR-39582 by changing MedicationRequest.renderedDosageInstruction from string to markdown; the same commit also carried unrelated FHIR-39142 MedicationRequest wording edits.
additional_context: Current R6 source no longer has a standalone MedicationRequest.renderedDosageInstruction element. MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction is now typed as DosageDetails, DosageDetails is an active normative datatype, and DosageDetails.renderedInstruction is markdown. Later dosage work, including the already-published FHIR-54014 reconciliation, preserved this successor field and made its narrative consistent with the required renderedInstruction rule.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no source edit is needed for the seed issue.

related_jiras.note: Established that converting string elements to markdown in a later FHIR version is not considered breaking and prompted review of string elements that may need multiple paragraphs.
Made DosageDetails.renderedInstruction mandatory and updated dosage narrative while preserving the markdown successor field used by MedicationRequest.
